thread:
maria_support: Hey team, customer Sam reports a voucher code returned 200 on redeem but their org balance didn't change. He pasted the UI success and the webhook payload. Can someone triage?

customer-sam: Confirmed — I clicked Redeem in the portal, saw the success modal and email. API returned 200 with grant id but usage/balance still shows 0. Org id: org_1789, user: sam@example.com.

maria_support: Thanks. Sam, can you paste the webhook body or the redeem response? Any transaction id?

customer-sam: Here is the response I got (copied from browser devtools):
```
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "status": "accepted",
  "grant_id": "g-0a1b2c3d4e",
  "amount": 5000,
  "currency": "USD",
  "applied_to": null
}
```
It shows applied_to null. The email shows the voucher code and amount.

alex_billing: Noted. If applied_to is null that implies the grant ingestion step succeeded but ledger assignment didn't run. Maria — can you confirm whether this org has an active billing account or a linked tenant? Sometimes grants are flagged to billing when tenant mismatch occurs.

maria_support: Org is active. I checked the account page — billing status: ACTIVE, billing_account_id: ba_3321. Sam says they signed up via SSO.

jordan_ops: Pasting what I'll check: 1) webhook delivery logs 2) grants ingestion queue 3) ledger write records for grant_id g-0a1b2c3d4e. If ingestion wrote to grants table but ledger write failed we should see an error in the job logs.

paul_engineer: I pulled logs for g-0a1b2c3d4e — ingestion record exists: grants.ingest -> status: processed, grant_payload.employeeId: null, mapped_org: org_1789. Ledger write attempted at 2026-03-15T18:12:02Z and returned 409 duplicate-key for write_key: ledger:org_1789:20260315181202. But that shouldn't block balance update; looks like the ledger job retried and then skipped. I'm seeing a notice: "skip_on_conflict=true" caused a no-op.

alex_billing: Hmm 409 usually means the ledger row exists already. Check if existing ledger row has amount=0 or the amount in question.

paul_engineer: Existing ledger row found with write_key ledger:org_1789:20260315181202 amount=0, reason="initializing placeholder", created by orphaned job from older flow. So the grant applied against a placeholder record and the batch that aggregates ledger->balance didn't pick it up because placeholder flag excludes grants.

maria_support: TL;DR: grant was accepted by webhook and ingestion created a grant, but because a placeholder ledger row existed the aggregation job skipped crediting org balance. I can push a manual fix but need approvals and audit record. Sam — do you want immediate manual credit or a rollback+reapply flow?

customer-sam: Immediate credit please — we need to run smoke tests. Any way to confirm what will show in UI and API after fix?

jordan_ops: We'll do a manual ledger correction: create a new ledger event with write_key ledger:org_1789:manual-repair-2169876543 and amount=5000, meta: {grant_id:g-0a1b2c3d4e, source:"voucher_repair"}. After that aggregation run should update org balance. I'll also queue a backfill job to mark placeholder rows and re-evaluate attached grants.

paul_engineer: I'll add an audit entry and send a signed-off ticket to compliance. Also opening GH issue to prevent skip_on_conflict from ignoring grants when placeholder exists.

alex_billing: FYI I verified billing_account ba_3321 will accept the credit; cost center is fine.

maria_support: Action items: @jordan_ops manual ledger event now; @paul_engineer create audit + GH issue; I'll message Sam when credited. Sam, can you confirm after ~10 minutes and share a screenshot of the balance endpoint (/v1/orgs/org_1789/balance)?

dev-bot: Ticket created: SUP-2026-0952. Linked GH: redwood-infra#4821.

jordan_ops: Manual ledger event created and aggregation triggered. New ledger row id lr-7781 created.

maria_support: Sam — can you check now?

customer-sam: I see the 5000 USD on the account now, balance endpoint returns: {"balance":5000}. Thanks everyone.

maria_support: Great — closing for now. We'll keep SUP-2026-0952 open until GH-4821 merged. Thanks all :tada:
